ezekiel.27.p1.b1.text: Now you, son of man, take up a lament for Tyre.

ezekiel.27.p1.b2.text: You have said, O Tyre, ‘I am perfect in beauty.’

ezekiel.27.p1.b3.text: They took a cedar from Lebanon to make a mast for you. … Of embroidered fine linen from Egypt they made your sail

ezekiel.27.p1.b4.text: The ships of Tarshish carried your merchandise. And you were filled with heavy cargo in the heart of the sea.

ezekiel.27.p2.b1.text: Your oarsmen have brought you onto the high seas, but the east wind will shatter you in the heart of the sea.

ezekiel.27.p2.b2.text: Now you are shattered by the seas in the depths of the waters; your merchandise and the people among you have gone down with you.

ezekiel.27.p2.b3.text: They will raise their voices for you and cry out bitterly. They will throw dust on their heads and roll in ashes.

ezekiel.27.p2.b4.text: Who was ever like Tyre, silenced in the middle of the sea?

ezekiel.27.p2.b5.text: you have come to a horrible end and will be no more.
